description: From the 2026-09-25 architecture review (turnkey-pru.9): mapper.go repeats seven functions per language, rulessync switches on language three times (sourcePatterns, detectLanguage, runExtractor), and isTestTarget treats any rule name containing 'test' as a test. Not done in turnkey-pru.9 because rules sync is disabled in turnkey's own sync.toml, so nothing here exercises it; pick up when a consumer enables rules sync.
title: Per-language plug-in for mapper/rulessync
